residualContract.body: callers must treat as opaque; cross-version comparisons go through the safer-spec-migrate skill
residualContract.reason: comparison logic is migrate's responsibility; the skill walks SPEC.md + sidecar artifacts during format-version transitions.

residualGuarantees.claim: value is a stable string literal across all calls within one process
residualGuarantees.reason: declared `as const` in source; re-evaluation cannot drift.

residualContract.body: dot-prefixed directories, `__tests__`, `node_modules`, `dist`, `build`, `coverage`, and `.safer-spec` are skipped; symlinks are not followed
residualContract.reason: avoid vendored dependencies, build output, and sidecar dirs.

residualGuarantees.claim: returns every directory under `root` containing an `index.ts` barrel; insertion order is root-first depth-first
residualGuarantees.reason: contract; both `generate` and `validate` iterate this list when no `--folder` is given. Walking from `.` finds barrels under any top-level layout (`src/`, `packages/<name>/`, app workspaces).

residualGuarantees.claim: returns immediate child directories of `folder` that contain an `index.ts` barrel; not recursive
residualGuarantees.reason: parent SPEC.md's `## Children` section lists immediate nested SPEC'd domains; deeper nesting belongs to each subfolder's own SPEC.

residualContract.body: folder match is exact-string against the normalized folder path; glob patterns are NOT supported in this slice
residualContract.reason: scope limit; glob lookup is a future enhancement that needs a defined longest-match resolution rule.

residualGuarantees.claim: returns a Thresholds value with each metric resolved in three-layer priority: folder override > defaultThresholds > 0
residualGuarantees.reason: validate's gate reads this per-folder; the layered fallback lets projects raise a baseline + tighten specific folders without restating the baseline everywhere.

residualContract.body: files are displayed by their path relative to the folder; subfolders are displayed with a trailing slash
residualContract.reason: visual cue for readers; subfolder links target `<sub>/SPEC.md`, file links target `./<rel>`.

residualGuarantees.claim: result emits in three concatenated groups: immediate SPEC'd subfolders (alphabetic), source files (alphabetic), then test files (alphabetic)
residualGuarantees.reason: implementation surface (subfolders + sources) leads `## Children`; tests are secondary documentation grouped at the end so the section reads as primary-then-secondary.

residualContract.body: missing tsconfig.json yields empty `paths`; missing `.git/HEAD` yields `generatedAtSha = 'uncommitted'`; missing safer-spec.config.json yields permissive all-zero thresholds
residualContract.reason: projects without aliases, git history, or per-folder gate configuration still load with no false failures.

residualGuarantees.claim: loads project-wide context (every non-test `.ts` under `root`, tsconfig `paths`, git HEAD SHA, `safer-spec.config.json`); collectExports consumes sources+paths so barrel re-exports resolve
residualGuarantees.reason: ts-morph cannot follow `export ... from` without target files registered; validate's threshold gate reads the loaded config.
